name: the wind's gust's sprite flag 0x80, BN6's
why: A wind's gust is each engine's own third-kind 0x49, spawned by the engine's wind (BN4's fourth-kind 0x41, its update's bl at 0x080E68C2 to 0x080D68AC; BN6's at 0x080E6636 to 0x080CECF8), its init twins (BN4 0x080D6748, BN6 0x080CEB80) but for one immediate: sprite_load writes its caller's r0 at the sprite state's +3 (BN4 0x0800288E push {r0,r1,r2} to 0x080028B6 strb r1,[r5,#3]; BN6 0x080026F6 to 0x0800271E, the same steps), and BN6's init passes 0x80 (movs r0,#0x80 at 0x080CEB90) where BN4's passes the r0 its +0 flags left (0x080D6750-0x080D6756: ldrb, orrs #2, strb). Its object's +0x93 is that byte: BN4 0x0E, BN6 0x8E (windman_v1 at t1, the gust of WindMan's first wind). With BN6's immediate made 0 (--poke 080CEB90:2000:2) +0x93 is alike at t1 and no other record of the battle moves. That bit alone, BN6's, on that object; its other bits compared as ever
